'''Arau''' is the royal capital of [[Perlis]] in northern [[Peninsular Malaysia]].

==Understand==
Despite being the royal capital, Arau is overshadowed by the Perlis' actual capital, [[Kangar]], which lies 14 km to the west of Arau. The town's main significance to travellers is its railway station, which gives access to the port at [[Kuala Perlis]], from where there are boats to [[Langkawi]] and [[Thailand]].

==See==
The Istana (palace) was built in the colonial era and is in the Moorish-British hybrid style that is typical of the British Empire's take on Islamic architecture. There is also a large mosque near the palace.
